row: SHAP is a mobile veterinary physiotherapy clinic owned and operated by a BSc qualified veterinary physiotherapist. Specialising in the rehabilitation of horses, dogs, and cats, the clinic offers expert care for animals recovering from surgeries, injuries, or managing chronic conditions. Additionally, SHAP provides conditioning services for animals involved in competitive sports, helping to optimize performance and prevent injuries. With a focus on improving mobility, reducing pain, and enhancing overall quality of life, personalised in-home treatment plans are tailored to meet each animal's unique needs. We bring professional physiotherapy services directly to your doorstep for the convenience and comfort of your animals.
